checks: Confirm the review window (2026-09-01 to 2026-11-30) and identify what changed since the last IDT review, using the enrollment date (2024-07-11) only as a baseline if no prior review date is on file.

Falls and near-falls: count and dates in the window, injuries, and any fall-related ED visits. Flag this especially given neuropathy due to T2DM, chronic back pain, osteoporosis, and metoprolol/amlodipine (orthostasis risk).
ED visits and hospital admissions or observation stays in the window, with reasons. Check for recurrent UTI, COPD exacerbation, chest pain or ischemic heart disease events, and sinusitis.
Recurrent UTI: number of episodes, urine culture results, antibiotic courses and their dates, and whether any antibiotic was a penicillin-class agent given the penicillin V allergy (wheal reaction).

Medication changes: starts and stops in the window versus the active list (metoprolol succinate, fluticasone/salmeterol inhaler, acetaminophen, albuterol nebulizer solution, alendronic acid, amlodipine 2.5 mg, clopidogrel, diphenhydramine, ferrous sulfate, hydrocortisone cream, nitroglycerin spray, simvastatin 20 mg). Flag the long-standing diphenhydramine (since 1981) as a Beers-list anticholinergic for review, and confirm clopidogrel and simvastatin are still intended.
Adherence and refill gaps for inhalers, antihypertensives, clopidogrel, and statin; check for duplicate or conflicting inhaled or antihypertensive therapy.

Diabetes and metabolic markers: most recent HbA1c, glucose trend, triglycerides, lipid panel, and kidney function (eGFR/creatinine, urine albumin) for the diabetic neuropathy and metabolic syndrome problems; note any missing labs due in the window.
Anemia follow-up: most recent hemoglobin and ferritin, whether ferrous sulfate is still being taken and effective, and any bleeding signs given clopidogrel use.
Vitals and weight: blood pressure trend (including orthostatic readings if recorded), heart rate, SpO2, and weight trend over the window, with any unexplained weight change.
Bone health and pain: osteoporosis treatment status and most recent DXA or fracture history; chronic pain and low back pain scores, analgesic use, and any new pain complaints or functional impact.

Function, cognition, and mood: ADL/IADL changes, cognitive screen results if due, mood screen (e.g., PHQ), and attendance at IDT-related visits or programs; caregiver status and any change in living situation or caregiver strain (lives in Napa).
